dct_description_sm: Save the River's PFAS Water Quality Monitoring project helps us protect both the environment and the residents within the St. Lawrence River watershed. PFAS Monitoring data is collected through Cyclopure PFAS Water Test Kits at different sites along the Upper St. Lawrence River to determine PFAS levels and trends in the watershed.
dct_title_s: Upper St. Lawrence River PFAS Water Quality Monitoring Data
